rounds.challenge_neighborhood: measurement-reconstruction + abstract mathematics + everyday fastening + computational algorithm

primary_sources.locator: G. N. Hounsfield, Computerized transverse axial scanning (tomography): Part 1. Description of system, British Journal of Radiology 46(552), 1016–1022 (1973), DOI 10.1259/0007-1285-46-552-1016
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: Multi-angle X-ray transmission measurements are computationally reconstructed into cross-sectional images.

primary_sources.locator: Samuel Eilenberg and Saunders Mac Lane, General Theory of Natural Equivalences, Transactions of the AMS 58(2), 231–294 (1945)
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: Category, functor and natural-transformation structure organizes relations among mathematical constructions.

primary_sources.locator: US3009235A, Separable Fastening Device, George de Mestral, filed 1958 / published 1961
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: Two hook-bearing fabric elements form a reusable separable fastening function through their composed interface.

primary_sources.locator: James W. Cooley and John W. Tukey, An Algorithm for the Machine Calculation of Complex Fourier Series, Mathematics of Computation 19(90), 297–301 (1965)
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: A reusable decomposition algorithm changes the computational procedure for evaluating complex Fourier series.

rounds.challenge_neighborhood: physics formulation + biotechnology construction + propulsion architecture + web-scale information retrieval

primary_sources.locator: R. P. Feynman, Space-Time Approach to Quantum Electrodynamics, Physical Review 76, 769–789 (1949), DOI 10.1103/PhysRev.76.769
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: The published formulation provides a space-time method for writing/evaluating matrix elements and discusses a modified interaction at short distances.

primary_sources.locator: S. N. Cohen, A. C. Y. Chang, H. W. Boyer, R. B. Helling, Construction of biologically functional bacterial plasmids in vitro, PNAS 70(11), 3240–3244 (1973), DOI 10.1073/pnas.70.11.3240
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: Restriction-generated DNA fragments from distinct plasmids are joined and transformed into bacteria as functional recombinant replicons.

primary_sources.locator: GB347206A, Improvements relating to the propulsion of aircraft and other vehicles, Frank Whittle, filed 1930
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: A compressor, combustion/heating stage, turbine and propelling nozzle are composed into a gas-turbine jet-propulsion architecture.

primary_sources.locator: Sergey Brin and Lawrence Page, The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine, Computer Networks 30, 107–117 (1998), DOI 10.1016/S0169-7552(98)00110-X
primary_sources.public_artifact_pressure: A large-scale search architecture exploits hyperlink structure together with crawling, indexing and ranking procedures.

reopen_rule: Any later primary-source artifact that requires a reusable public structural relation outside DiscoveryMorphologyBasis.v1 reopens the basis and resets both no-material-change rounds.
